text: Characteristics of the Project 1. HSK and BCT 2. Chinese Characters and calligraphy 3. Taijiquan (Tai Chi Chuan) 4. Chinese Traditional Musical Instruments 5. High-quality Chinese cultural activities Tuition Fee One-semester program: 7000/semester One-year program: 14000/year Course Introduction Long-term Chinese language programs begin in March and September respectively, and the duration of each program varies from one semester, one year, to two years. These programs cater to five different proficiency levels of Chinese, starting from the elementary level (I and II) and leading to intermediate (I and II) and advanced levels. Major courses for long-term Chinese learners include Elementary Chinese, Oral Chinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese Reading, Chinese Composition, HSK Test Preparations, Chinese Culture, Chinese Music, Taiji Boxing, and Chinese Conversation. Students who have completed the required courses of study and obtain a passing grade in all examinations will be awarded a certificate.
